[message_id=3433006 author=Irving Ernesto first=False]
Honestly, no. Lately the competitions have downgraded into people who have the necessary compute being able to win. I'm not saying they don't put effort, they put a massive amount of effort, but the barrier to win has increased massively in terms of having the right amount of VRAM, not only for this but for a lot of competitions where Deep Learning is king.
You can get a good ranking, though.
